fieldSemantics.pressure: The real burden, anomaly, opportunity or constraint that made the trajectory worth pursuing.
fieldSemantics.preExistingWorldModel: What relevant actors could reasonably believe before the decisive transition; include contested theories and missing knowledge.
fieldSemantics.candidateRoutes: Serious competing scientific/technical/organizational approaches available at the time.
fieldSemantics.observationsAndInstruments: Measurements, instruments, prototypes, trials, data or empirical observations that changed the search frontier.
fieldSemantics.decisiveTests: Evidence that discriminated among live alternatives. If no decisive test existed, record that explicitly.
fieldSemantics.technicalOrScientificTransition: What physically or epistemically changed; avoid hero-inventor shorthand.
fieldSemantics.complements: Materials, machine tools, infrastructure, standards, capital, skills, institutions, scientific theory or downstream innovations required for the result to matter.
fieldSemantics.rivalsAndFailures: Failed routes, abandoned mechanisms, priority disputes, false theories and reasons for rejection or displacement.
fieldSemantics.diffusionAndScaling: Adoption path, latency, geographic/sector spread and bottlenecks between proof and broad consequence.
fieldSemantics.standardsAndInstitutions: Patents, regulation, standards, labs, firms, governments, funding systems or professional communities affecting selection/diffusion.
fieldSemantics.externalitiesAndCorrections: Safety failures, environmental/social costs, regulatory corrections, misuse or later reversals.
fieldSemantics.secondOrderEffects: New experimental capability, lower research cost, new industries, new questions or other metaproductive consequences.
fieldSemantics.sourceNativeSummary: A concise synthesis written before any LW0 structural coding.
fieldSemantics.codingState: Must be source_locked before motif coding begins.
